iti8:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti8:2.1: Mānaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya. Mānañca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetam iti vuccati:
iti8:3.1: Mānupetā ayaṃ pajā mānaganthā bhave ratā | mānaṃ aparijānantā āgantāro punabbhavaṃ ||
iti8:4.1: Ye ca mānaṃ pahatvāna vimuttā mānasaṅkhaye | te mānaganthābhibhūno sabbadukkhaṃ upaccagun-ti ||
iti8:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||8||
